text: Very logical, Deanna... But your heart doesn't constrain itself to mere logic. ... Your heart longs to discover me. To know me... ... To leave all of this behind and be with me.
scene_context: Turbolift: Shinzon speaks to Deanna while moving toward her, discussing her heart and leaving everything behind.

text: I can feel your hunger to know the Reman ways... the old ways.
scene_context: On the Scimitar, discussing Reman ways with Viceroy/Deanna

text: Don't fear what you desire...
scene_context: On the turbolift, speaking to Deanna about desire

text: Disable their weapons!
scene_context: On the Scimitar, ordering Viceroy to disable weapons

text: Report!
scene_context: On the Scimitar, after ship attack, demanding report

text: I'll show you my true nature. Your nature. And as Earth dies -- remember that I'm forever Shinzon of Remus! And my voice will echo through time long after yours has faded to a dim memory.
scene_context: Transmission to Picard: Shinzon reveals his true nature and his plan for Earth's destruction.

text: I don't know.
scene_context: Conversation with Picard about their father and Shinzon's choices.

text: That's your life... not mine.
scene_context: Conversation with Picard about their father and Shinzon's choices.

text: It's too late.
scene_context: Conversation with Picard about their father and Shinzon's choices.

text: I have no choices! I can't fight what I am!
scene_context: Conversation with Picard about their father and Shinzon's choices.

text: Hello, Jean Luc.
scene_context: Shinzon greets Picard in a room with a force field.

text: I was lonely... Perhaps I'm not aging as well as you did.
scene_context: Shinzon explains his loneliness and comments on his aging to Picard.

text: I need a sample of your blood. What do your Borg friends say? Resistance is futile.
scene_context: Shinzon requests Picard's blood and references the Borg.

text: I think the facts speak for themselves. The same noble Picard blood runs in our veins. Had you lived my life, you'd be doing exactly as I am. Look in the mirror, and see yourself.
scene_context: With Picard; discussing shared bloodline and mirror metaphor

text: Consider that, Captain. I can think of no greater torment for you.
scene_context: With Picard; stating torment and preparing to leave

text: Let her pursue -- drop cloak on the aft port quadrant and prepare for full emergency stop.
scene_context: Shinzon gives ship maneuver orders to the Viceroy.

text: You heard me.
scene_context: Shinzon responds to the Viceroy's startled reaction.

text: Not yet.
scene_context: On ship, Shinzon and Viceroy discussing the Valdore's approach.

text: FULL STOP AND FIRE !
scene_context: On ship, Shinzon ordering the crew to stop and fire.

text: Find her again.
scene_context: Viceroy states bond is broken, Shinzon orders to find her.

text: Do as I tell you!
scene_context: Viceroy objects to wasting time, Shinzon demands compliance.

text: On my way.
scene_context: Shinzon responds to Reman officer's comm report on transponder signal.

text:
I see an old man, set in his ways,
afraid to live without a uniform to
prop him up and a Starfleet
regulation to tell him what to do.
I see the man I will never be.
scene_context: Confrontation with Picard: Shinzon responds to Picard's statement about a young man denying identity.

text:
My life is meaningless as long as
you're alive. What am I while you
exist? A shadow? An enigma?
scene_context: Confrontation with Picard: Shinzon declares his life is meaningless while Picard exists.

text: Long ago.
scene_context: Conversation with Picard: Shinzon reflects on his past

text: Childish dreams, Captain. Lost in the dilithium mines of Remus. I'm what you see now.
scene_context: Conversation with Picard: Shinzon describes his past and current state

text: He is what his life has made him!
scene_context: Conversation with Picard: Shinzon reacts to Picard's challenge
